title: Retrospective harness rollout
summary: Project iteration record for landing the authoritative retrospective schema, validator, harness gate, daily publish writer/finalizer/correction flow, publish submission boundary, tests, and seed index.

lessons.lesson: Retrospective learning must be stored as repo-owned data, not only in chat or temporary task state.
lessons.evidence: The final design uses independent records plus retrospectives/index.json as the lightweight authority.
lessons.recommended_action: Require every non-trivial delivery to update or justify the retrospective record surface.

suggestions.issue: Retrospective suggestions can become ambiguous unless their lifecycle status and proof are explicit.
suggestions.evidence: The schema requires suggestion.status and the validator enforces evidence for implemented suggestions.
suggestions.suggestion: Keep suggestions stateful with observed, recommended, accepted, implemented, or rejected status.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future readers can distinguish observations from accepted or shipped process changes.
suggestions.promotion_path: Bound through the feedback ledger and unit validation.
validation_evidence: retrospective validation accepts sanitized records and index
retrospective validation rejects implemented suggestions without durable evidence
daily runner writes sanitized daily publish retrospective before validation
daily runner finalizes publish retrospectives before real publish
daily runner writes blocked correction rollup when publish and fallback fail
daily dry-run stages sanitized retrospective records for the selected date
daily dry-run stages selected-date rollup correction retrospective records
publish keeps dirty retrospective records scoped to the selected report date

followups.action: Daily publish writer integration, publish-mode finalization, blocked correction rollups, and selected-date publish staging are included in this delivery.
